recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-19484 unless FM later reopens the UDI/device naming model addressed by FHIR-20175.
issue_request: FHIR-19484 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FM change request to add UDI to procedure on Claim, with Claim and ExplanationOfBenefit listed as related artifacts.
initial_application: The change appears to have been applied in afb5ec66f68641293bb7950b6e0eeb118fa1444a, whose subject explicitly includes '19484: Add UDI to procedure on Claim'. The post-commit Claim spreadsheet contains Claim.procedure.udi as 0..* Reference(Device) and a Claim-procedure-udi search parameter; later source refactors carried that into current StructureDefinition XML and search parameter bundle files.
additional_context: Claim and ExplanationOfBenefit are active resources in source/fhir.ini. Current Claim and ExplanationOfBenefit StructureDefinitions both define procedure.udi as 0..* Reference(Device), and both search parameter bundles include procedure-udi parameters. FHIR-20175 later proposed renaming Claim.procedure.udi to device, but it was Resolved - No Change/Not Persuasive because UDI is a well-known domain term.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The published empty commit records that the current source already satisfies the requested procedure-level UDI addition and that the later naming challenge does not require a core edit.

related_jiras.note: Later Not Persuasive request to rename Claim.procedure.udi to device confirms that retaining the UDI element name is intentional.
